head.title: The Home Tiles · Tile & Stone Showroom in Hialeah, FL
head.description: The Home Tiles, a family tile and natural stone showroom in Hialeah, FL: 4.8 stars from 133 Google reviews. Staff help you pick tile for bathrooms, kitchens and outdoor stone. Call (305) 884-3660.

jsonld.description: The Home Tiles is a family tile and natural stone showroom in Hialeah, FL, helping customers choose tile and stone for bathrooms, kitchens and outdoor spaces.

eyebrow.es: Hialeah, FL · Tile y Piedra Natural

parrafo.es: Showroom familiar de tile y piedra natural en Hialeah. Clientes reales describen al equipo guiandolos paso a paso para elegir el tile correcto para su bano o cocina, sin perderse entre tantas opciones.
parrafo.en: A family tile and natural stone showroom in Hialeah. Real reviewers describe the team walking them through every step of picking the right tile for a bathroom or kitchen, without getting lost in the options.

hero.imagen_alt: The Home Tiles storefront and tile yard in Hialeah, FL

parrafo_1.es: The Home Tiles es un showroom familiar de tile y piedra natural en Hialeah. El piso de venta esta lleno de muestras de las principales marcas, de porcelanato a marmol, para que veas y toques el material antes de decidir.
parrafo_1.en: The Home Tiles is a family tile and natural stone showroom in Hialeah. The showroom floor is stocked with samples from major brands, from porcelain to marble, so you can see and touch the material before you decide.

parrafo_2.es: Resenas reales cuentan como el equipo ayuda a elegir todo lo necesario para una renovacion de bano sin saltarse ningun paso, con precios claros y buen servicio.
parrafo_2.en: Real reviews describe the team helping customers pick out everything needed for a bathroom renovation without missing a step, with clear pricing and helpful service.

texto.es: Cuentanos tu proyecto, de un bano a un deck de piscina, por telefono o en el showroom.
texto.en: Tell us about your project, from a bathroom to a pool deck, by phone or at the showroom.

texto.es: El equipo te muestra opciones reales del piso de venta hasta encontrar el tile correcto.
texto.en: The team walks you through real samples on the showroom floor until you land on the right tile.

texto.es: Recibes el precio segun el material y los pies cuadrados que necesitas, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: You get pricing based on the material and square footage you need, no surprises.

texto.es: Coordinas la entrega o retiras el tile y la piedra listos para tu instalador.
texto.en: Arrange delivery or pick up the tile and stone ready for your installer.

subtitulo.es: Un showroom de tile y piedra natural, con el equipo para ayudarte a elegir y resolver tu proyecto.
subtitulo.en: A tile and natural stone showroom, with the team to help you pick and plan your project.

nota.es: Los precios se cotizan en persona segun el material y los pies cuadrados que necesites. Visita el showroom o llama para tu cotizacion.
nota.en: Pricing is quoted in person based on the material and square footage you need. Stop by the showroom or call for your quote.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llama igual: el showroom recibe material nuevo con frecuencia.
pie.en: Do not see what you are after? Call anyway: new material comes into the showroom often.

texto.es: Reseñas reales cuentan como el equipo ayuda a decidir entre decenas de opciones hasta encontrar el tile exacto que buscabas.
texto.en: Real reviewers describe the team helping narrow down dozens of options until you land on the exact tile you were picturing.

texto.es: Porcelanato y marmol para banos y cocinas completas, del tipo que se ve en nuestras instalaciones terminadas.
texto.en: Porcelain and marble for full bathroom and kitchen renovations, the kind you see in our finished installs.

texto.es: Travertino y piedra para decks de piscina y muros de chimenea, pensados para resistir el exterior de Florida.
texto.en: Travertine and stone for pool decks and fireplace walls, built to hold up outdoors in Florida.

texto.es: Decenas de muestras de las principales marcas en el piso de venta, para decidir con el material en la mano.
texto.en: Dozens of samples from major brands on the showroom floor, so you decide with the material in your hands.

items.quote: We bought the tiles for our two bathrooms and front porch at this store. We received excellent service and great prices. Everyone here is very helpful and knowledgeable and were able to guide me to finding the best tiles and materials to match. This is my go to place to shop tiles.

Have you ever gone to pick out tile and did not know what to get? Well, if you go to Home Tiles, you must have. Yudith Cruz helps you pick out everything you need to complete a bathroom renovation. She does not miss a step.
I looked at many places for tiles and finally found a great place to buy, The Home Tiles. Jenny and Judit helped me and got a tile that I was looking for as well as all the materials needed.

texto.es: La via mas rapida para preguntar por disponibilidad o pedir tu cotizacion.
texto.en: The fastest way to ask about availability or get your quote.

texto.es: Lunes a viernes 7am a 5pm, sabados 7am a 4pm. Domingos cerrado.
texto.en: Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm, Saturdays 7am to 4pm. Closed Sundays.

parrafo.es: Visita el showroom o llama ahora. Te ayudamos a elegir el tile y la piedra correctos para tu espacio.
parrafo.en: Visit the showroom or call now. We will help you choose the right tile and stone for your space.
